definition: the season when leaves fall from the trees
description: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

de.answer: Er fängt unter einem Baum herabschwebende Blätter.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está atrapando hojas que caen bajo un árbol.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il attrape des feuilles qui virevoltent sous un arbre.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
